summary: Alerts from the scan of X, which runs every 5 minutes by day and every 30 minutes overnight (2:00 am to 10:00 am Singapore time). Event time is when the incident happened, which can differ from when it was reported; it says not stated when sources don't give it.

netRead.lead: Net read: supply risk is rising.
netRead.text: Thirty-one of forty alerts point to higher prices, centered on Iran, the Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz (now including a UKMTO warning that a tanker was struck by two projectiles 72 nm east of Ras Al Khafji, taking the attacks up into the northern Gulf, an IRGC Navy claim via IRNA that two oil tankers exploded on mines on an unauthorized Hormuz route with a supertanker ablaze, a UKMTO warning of a merchant vessel struck by an unknown projectile in Hormuz late on 1 Nov, Iran's blanket enforcement against Sinokor, the tanker owner moving about a third of Gulf crude, taking effect from 1 Nov, Iran's security chief Rezaei saying Hormuz stays closed until Tehran's seven conditions are met, an i24NEWS report that the IDF has raised its alert level and could join renewed US operations against Iran within hours, an Iranian navy claim via state media that an oil tanker caught fire in Hormuz after hitting naval mines, unconfirmed reports and footage of a Kuwaiti oil tanker targeted in Hormuz, Iran's foreign minister demanding recognition of a new Oman-agreed Hormuz shipping lane and closure of other routes as the price of reopening, Iran's official confirmation that US forces attacked fishing boats off Qeshm Island, Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei ordering commanders to respond to any threat without geographical limits, India's confirmation that the ADNOC-managed VLCC ARZANAH was hit on 29 Oct, a new UKMTO report of a crude tanker hit by a projectile while leaving Hormuz, an IRGC claim that a fourth tanker, a supertanker, exploded in Hormuz, an Israeli TV report that strike preparations against Iran are complete, a projectile strike and fire on what appears to be a Qatari LNG tanker south of Lavan Island, a vessel set ablaze and evacuated off Musandam and an Iranian claim of a US drone boat destroyed) and the Saudi-Houthi war, where Saudi-led airstrikes overnight hit the Houthis' Ras Isa fuel terminal in Hodeidah, an emergency alert sounded in Jazan amid a Houthi claim of a missile strike on Aramco facilities there and Bloomberg reports the main crude unit at Ras Tanura is shut after Houthi damage, plus a large fire at Lukoil's Kstovo refinery after an overnight Ukrainian drone attack on 1 Nov, a reported refinery fire in Ufa after a Ukrainian drone attack and Zelenskyy saying Ukraine's strikes can now reach from Yamal to Western Siberia, Ukrainian officials telling the Kyiv Independent the refinery strike campaign continues despite a US proposal for a 30-day halt, a tighter diesel market with Russia now extending its diesel export ban through January and a new Libyan pipeline shutdown by an armed group. The offsets are a leaked, unconfirmed Qatari-brokered draft framework under which Iran would hand over its roughly 440 kg of highly enriched uranium and reopen Hormuz within seven days, Araghchi saying a new proposal with Qatari mediators would reopen Hormuz within two days of a deal, an unconfirmed Al-Araby Al-Jadeed report of a breakthrough that would bring a US delegation to Doha for direct talks with Iran, an Al Hadath report that US strike options for Iran leave out oil facilities, Trump saying the Iran war will wrap up soon, Qatar's revised proposals, a WSJ report that Washington is pushing to restore Russian gas flows to Europe via Ukraine as part of an energy truce between Moscow and Kyiv, a 40 million barrel US SPR loan and a sourced report that OPEC+ will hold December output targets steady, but Tehran hasn't answered yet.

brent.detail: hit $117 on the Hormuz tanker fires, per OilPrice.com

alerts.headline: WSJ: Washington is pushing to restore Russian gas flows to Europe via Ukraine, aiming to secure an energy truce between Moscow and Kyiv that could pause strikes on energy sites
alerts.source: WSJ report, relayed by LiveSquawk, First Squawk, RedboxGlobal and FinancialJuice

alerts.headline: UKMTO warning 192-26: a tanker heading southeast through the northern Gulf was struck on its port side by two unknown projectiles 72 nm east of Ras Al Khafji, Saudi Arabia; crew accounted for, no spill. OSINT accounts blame the IRGC, which is unconfirmed
alerts.source: UKMTO, relayed by Iran International English and NTC Report; IRGC attribution from AMK Mapping

alerts.eventTime: Overnight 1–2 Nov, roughly 12–5 am SGT 2 Nov (est.)
alerts.headline: Saudi-led coalition airstrikes hit Ras Isa, the Houthis' main fuel import terminal in Hodeidah, striking its pier and a docked ship plus an oil company station in Bajil; Houthi health ministry says 7 injured. Claims the port is out of service are unconfirmed
alerts.source: Houthi health ministry via Al Jazeera Now, Middle East Observer and Yemeni media

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (IRGC says 'today', 1 Nov Iran time)
alerts.headline: IRGC Navy says two oil tankers exploded after hitting naval mines while using an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz with AIS off; it says one, a supertanker, is ablaze. UKMTO has not confirmed the blasts
alerts.source: IRNA (Iranian state news agency), relayed by Reuters and Roya News

alerts.headline: UKMTO Warning 191-26: a merchant vessel was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz after another ship relayed a Mayday; ships told to transit with caution
alerts.source: UKMTO Warning 191-26, via DC Global News

alerts.headline: Large fire at Lukoil's Kstovo refinery (NORSI, about 17 million tonnes a year) in Nizhny Novgorod region after an overnight Ukrainian drone attack, the third Russian refinery hit in three days; local fuel queues reported
alerts.source: UNN (Ukrainian, translated) and local footage

alerts.headline: Iran's Hormuz authority (PGSA) blanket enforcement against South Korean owner Sinokor's entire tanker fleet takes effect from 1 Nov; Sinokor carried about 37% of Hormuz oil transits in September and over half of VLCC traffic in early October
alerts.source: Persian Gulf Strait Authority notice of 27 Oct, via ZeroHedge (Lloyd's List data)

alerts.headline: Iran's security chief Rezaei says the Strait of Hormuz will stay closed until Tehran's conditions are fulfilled; Tehran has sent Washington seven conditions and says there will be no negotiation until they are met
alerts.source: Fars News, via FinancialJuice and Open Source Intel

alerts.headline: i24NEWS: the IDF has raised its alert level ahead of a possible resumption of joint US-Israeli military operations against Iran and is ready to enter the war within hours if a decision is made, though readiness has not peaked
alerts.source: i24NEWS, via Open Source Intel

alerts.headline: Iran's navy says an oil tanker caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz after colliding with naval mines, per Iranian state media; vessel not named and it is unclear whether this is a new incident
alerts.source: Iranian state media, via FinancialJuice and CGTN Africa

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (Kyiv Independent report, 12:34 am, 1 Nov)
alerts.headline: Ukrainian officials tell the Kyiv Independent the campaign of strikes on Russian oil refineries is ongoing, rejecting reports that Kyiv agreed to suspend it; no halt order was given despite US envoy Kushner's proposal for a 30-day pause
alerts.source: The Kyiv Independent (citing Ukrainian officials)

alerts.headline: OPEC+ agrees in principle to keep its December production targets unchanged, a source says
alerts.source: FinancialJuice, CGTN Europe, NodeWire (citing a source)

alerts.headline: Leaked draft of a preliminary Qatari-brokered US-Iran framework reportedly has Tehran handing its roughly 440 kg of highly enriched uranium to an agreed third country and reopening the Strait of Hormuz to shipping within 7 days; no final deal yet
alerts.source: Abdulrahman Al-Rashed (Arabic), Mostafa Gorji citing an Asharq Al-Awsat reporter (Persian), Abdulaziz Al Oqab (Arabic)

alerts.headline: Reports and new footage say a Kuwaiti oil tanker was targeted in the Strait of Hormuz today; the footage describes it as a 'violating ship' hit in the strait, and who carried out the strike was not stated
alerts.source: Post Open Source (via AB4_Ali3), Iraq Al-Hadath TV (Arabic), The Observer

alerts.headline: Araghchi tells Al Jazeera that a new proposal reached with Qatari mediators cuts the time to implement Iran's plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to two days (down from five, and seven before that); Tehran's conditions include lifting sanctions, fewer US forces in the region and recognition of the new shipping route
alerts.source: Araghchi via Al Jazeera Breaking News, also Iran International English and Entekhab (Persian)

alerts.headline: Iran's FM Araghchi tells Al Jazeera that Tehran wants recognition of a new Strait of Hormuz shipping lane agreed with Oman and the closure of alternative routes, says reopening Hormuz on Iran's terms would pave the way to resume talks with Washington, and that only Iran's proposal for reopening Hormuz is on the table
alerts.source: Araghchi via Al Jazeera, relayed by CGTN Africa and FinSquawk

alerts.headline: Russia's Deputy PM Novak says the government is preparing to extend its diesel export ban until the end of January 2027, with some exceptions (Interfax), pushing the curb past the earlier year-end date
alerts.source: Novak via Interfax, relayed by First Squawk, RedboxGlobal and Tracy Shuchart

alerts.headline: Iran officially confirms US forces attacked fishing boats off Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, a provincial official tells state media (Reuters); Fars says two fishermen missing and two wounded
alerts.source: Iranian provincial official via state media and Reuters, relayed by Post Open Source; earlier Tasnim and Fars via RedboxGlobal

alerts.headline: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, meeting senior armed forces commanders, orders an immediate, effective response without geographical limitations to any potential enemy threat
alerts.source: Supreme Leader's office statement, relayed by CGTN Europe

alerts.headline: Al-Araby Al-Jadeed reports a breakthrough in indirect US-Iran talks after Qatari mediation, with a US delegation expected to join Iranian negotiators in Doha for direct talks after preliminary understandings on the nuclear file and Hormuz
alerts.source: Al-Araby Al-Jadeed (unnamed sources), relayed by Faytuks Network, Cairo 24 and Kan via Akka

alerts.headline: Zelenskyy says Ukraine can now strike Russian targets from Yamal to Western Siberia, the core of Russia's oil and gas output, and is extending drone and missile reach with future strike directions identified
alerts.source: Visioner (single report of Zelenskyy remarks)

alerts.headline: Saudi Civil Defense issued an emergency early-warning alert for Jazan (Jizan) at about 3:07 pm SGT and lifted it three minutes later; small accounts say the Houthis claim a ballistic missile hit Aramco energy facilities in Jizan, home to a 400,000 b/d refinery and export terminal
alerts.source: Saudi Civil Defense (alert, confirmed); Houthi strike claim via World Conflict and Raaz News (unconfirmed)

alerts.headline: Ukrainian drones hit Ufa's industrial zone in Bashkortostan; explosions confirmed by Kyiv Independent citing Russian media, and locals report a fire at an oil refinery
alerts.source: Kyiv Independent; Ateo Breaking (Russian); local reports via Exilenova+

alerts.headline: Al Hadath: CENTCOM's briefing to Trump included options to hit Iran's nuclear sites, energy facilities and infrastructure, but excluded oil facilities
alerts.source: Al Hadath correspondent Hussein al-Toud (Arabic)

alerts.headline: India's shipping minister says the ADNOC-managed, Liberia-flagged VLCC ARZANAH was hit by a projectile near Hormuz on 29 Oct (2 Indian crew safe); likely not separately reported by UKMTO
alerts.source: India's shipping minister, relayed by Open Source Intel and Bering Report

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (late report; UKMTO notice issued 4:13 am, 31 Oct)
alerts.headline: UKMTO: a crude oil tanker was struck by an unknown projectile while transiting out of the Strait of Hormuz, per a verified source
alerts.source: UKMTO notice relayed by CGTN Europe

alerts.eventTime: Fri 30 Oct afternoon Iran time (~7:30 pm SGT, est.)
alerts.headline: IRGC Navy claims a fourth tanker, a supertanker that ignored its warnings, exploded in the Strait of Hormuz this afternoon
alerts.source: IRGC Navy statement relayed by CGTN Europe

alerts.headline: Israel's Channel 14 reports Israel has raised defensive and offensive readiness to high levels and finalized military preparations for an attack on Iran
alerts.source: Israeli Channel 14 report, via Post Open Source

alerts.headline: OSINT tracking suggests the vessel hit by a projectile south of Lavan Island is the Qatari-owned LNG tanker AL MAYEDA, which slowed and turned around at the time of the strike
alerts.source: MenchOsint ship-tracking analysis of the UKMTO notice

alerts.headline: UKMTO: a vessel was hit on its port side by an unknown projectile 40 nm south of Iran's Lavan Island in the central Gulf, causing a fire onboard; crew safe, no environmental impact reported
alerts.source: UKMTO notice, via ILRedAlert, Faytuks Network and CGTN

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (shutdown follows Houthi attacks about 3 days ago, ~27 Oct)
alerts.headline: Bloomberg: Aramco has shut the main crude distillation unit at its 550,000 b/d Ras Tanura refinery, Saudi Arabia's largest, after damage from Houthi attacks; the unit is expected to stay offline
alerts.source: Bloomberg report, via The Hormuz Letter and Conflict Alarm

alerts.eventTime: ~6:00 am, 30 Oct (est., pumping halted around midnight Libya time)
alerts.headline: Libya's NOC says an armed group shut the valve on the main Hamada-Zawiya crude pipeline at Al-Riyayna, forcing a halt to pumping to the Zawiya refinery
alerts.source: Libya NOC statement, via Giovanni Staunovo, CGTN and Libyan outlets

alerts.eventTime: Friday 30 Oct; Oman notice posted ~9:09 pm
alerts.headline: Oman says a Panama-flagged vessel was attacked and caught fire 1.6 nm off Musandam; all 25 crew evacuated. IRGC separately claims a third tanker today, a supertanker with over 2M barrels, exploded on a mine
alerts.source: Oman Maritime Security Centre, via Open Source Intel and Al Mayadeen; IRGC claim via Press TV

alerts.headline: Iran's navy claims it destroyed a US unmanned vessel (drone boat) in the eastern Strait of Hormuz; no US confirmation
alerts.source: Iranian state media, via Sky News

alerts.headline: Trump says the Iran war is 'going to get wrapped up soon' and Iran 'has to make a deal'; Qatari mediators brought revised proposals to Tehran, reply expected by the weekend
alerts.source: Reuters, Sky News; CBS News via Open Source Intel

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (Reuters report published ~12:05 am, 30 Oct)
alerts.headline: Reuters: Russia to extend its diesel export ban to year-end, using quotas only to meet its new export commitment to the US
alerts.source: Reuters (two sources), via Kashish Parpiani

alerts.headline: US loans 40 million barrels of oil from the SPR, its last share of the global (IEA) release agreement
alerts.source: Giovanni Staunovo, UBS, linking a news report

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (letter sent last week per NYT; reports surfaced ~10:17 am, 30 Oct)
alerts.headline: US VP Vance offers to meet Iran's security chief Rezaei for talks to end the war; Iran confirms the letter, hasn't replied, and dismisses a Qatari peace plan
alerts.source: Iran International (WaPo report), Israel War Room, Mossadil; NYT and WSJ also cited

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (just before the posts, est.)
alerts.headline: Ukrainian drones hit Novokuybyshevsk (Samara) in Russia; refinery likely target, large fires reported
alerts.source: AMK Mapping, Woofers, Mockingjay News UA

alerts.headline: UKMTO: tanker leaving Hormuz hit by a small boat that attached two explosive devices; fire now out, crew safe
alerts.source: UKMTO, First Squawk, RedboxGlobal
